It's great fun making lots of noise at first, but soon Crocky tires of the bucket stuck on his foot. How can Raa Raa and the other jungle animals help Crocky remove the bucket?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E47 — NeighboursBluey goes to Mum for advice about pesky neighbours when her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's huge stable of animals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E34 — The Comic BadgeDuggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Luckily, Duggee has the comic badge, so he can show the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: S3 E14 — Chantelle and Rory: JellyfishCarys wants to find out all about jellyfish. Chantelle visits an aquarium which is home to some rather special jellyfish, whilst Rory meets a marine expert, and they head out to sea on a glass-bottomed boat. Chantelle and Rory's fact files help answer all of Carys's questions.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: S5 E9 — Meet George and Freddie's FamilyGeorge and Freddie love having fun. After a hearty breakfast, they fill their day with family 'eggsperiments', art and even set up an obstacle course for Mum and Dad to complete. It looks easy at first until they learn they have to do it blindfolded.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Ginger the Gingerbread ManJen amazes Small with her tap-dancing skills. Small finds out how ginger is grown and ground. Plus, the two chefs cheer up a lonely gingerbread man with some gingerbread friends.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Mission: Wake Up!Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission, to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There's a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It's the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel's superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane's ears.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: S2 E35 — Aneeshwar and Lizzie: Eland and Colobus MonkeyAneeshwar and Lizzie meet some elands and colobus monkeys.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Air Traffic ControllerExplore the things that people might carry in their bags and why. Meet people from different backgrounds and jobs to find out more about them.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Waffle's Talent HuntThe After School Club hosts its first talent show, but when the key to a snack treasure chest goes missing, Waffle steps up to save the day.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Stormy WeatherOona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E39 — March of the AntsTwinkle discovers an army of marching ants taking seeds from her vegetable garden. When all attempts to stop them fail, she and Yukee try to find a way to get the ants marching to a different beat and away from her garden.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Swing MeLu, Gus, Declan, Biba, Barnaby, and Elodie have fun at the playground on a dry day, but Elodie ends up leaving Lu feeling sad when she forgets her promise to push her on the swing.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E48 — Board GameThe Piggies wonder what's more fun: playing outside or a board game. So, Charlie builds a giant outdoor board game, but their competitiveness ruins the fun!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S3 E5 — ZeroWhen there is nothing there to count and none is the amount, nobody does it better than Zero. Learn about the number zero.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S2 E19 — BoxWith a dressing up box it must be showtime! B, O and X discover a dressing up box that is filled with everything they need to put on a performance of Sleeping Beauty, except for something to sleep on.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E10 — We're All Friends: JumpJustin and George meet a friend for gymnastics, and Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E49 — TogetherDipsy and Laa-Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E10 — SeaweedRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how seaweed plays such an important role in the environment. They find out that seaweed can be a shelter for lots of sea creatures, a great place for seabirds to look for food to eat, and that seaweed helps provide some of the oxygen we breathe. On the way, they see what they can spot in a rock pool and have a picnic of some snacks made from seaweed!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: S2 E12 — Traffic Lights and Emergency LightsMaddie is looking at useful lights. She finds out how traffic lights work, making sure that vehicles can safely travel through a road junction.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Pedal MachinesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are pedal powered. Grace drives a pedal car, shows off a pedal glider and then has a race with Speedy on a water bike.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E16 — Kindness DayMrs Farrell and Miss Gerrard have Kindness Day, so the class show how they can be extra kind. Jessica and Orla draw lovely pictures for the teachers, and Sam helps Solomon with his yoghurt at lunchtime.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Saltwater CrocodileWhen a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of Benjamin's Strawberry RaidWhen Benjamin takes charge of a strawberry harvest raid on Mr McGregor's garden, he learns that it's harder than he thought to be a good leader.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E12 — The Opposites BadgeNorrie is having fun looking at nature in the garden. When Roly wants to join in, she tells him he needs to be really quiet, but he gets overexcited, shouting so loudly that he scares a lovely butterfly away. Norrie is put out because Roly did the opposite of what she said. When Roly asks what an opposite is, Norrie struggles to explain. Luckily, Duggee has his Opposites Badge and helps the squirrels understand by using lots of fun examples.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Flutter's Fossil FindThe Piris find a skeleton buried in the ice and think it's an ancient ancestor. But after a series of strange discoveries, things take an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E76 — Mission SuspicionThe farmer calls the FBI to investigate the weird happenings on the farm. As he shows the agents all the chaos, the Weasy Family watch and remember all of their craziest adventures.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: (500) Days of Summer
programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: The Bob's Burgers Movie
programme.desc: Bob Belcher and wife Linda run a hamburger restaurant in a close-knit seaside community. Stress piles on the couple's shoulders when a water main ruptures and creates a huge sinkhole in front of their business. Meanwhile, Belcher children Tina, Gene and Louise solve a murderous mystery. Animated comedy, with the voices of H John Benjamin, John Roberts, Kristen Schaal and Dan Mintz.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Cool Runnings
programme.desc: A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: John Carter
programme.desc: An American Civil War soldier is transported to an alien planet, which is also being torn apart by conflict. He intercedes in this struggle after rescuing a princess from captivity, and must win the trust of a fierce primitive tribe to save the world. Fantasy adventure based on Edgar Rice Burroughs' series of novels, starring Taylor Kitsch and Lynn Collins.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programme.desc: The superhuman soldier becomes an operative for secret intelligence agency SHIELD, but grows suspicious of their motives. Following a battle with a mysterious cyborg assassin, he and fellow Avenger Black Widow become fugitives, and try to bring down a sinister conspiracy. Comic-book thriller sequel, starring Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson, Samuel L Jackson and Robert Redford.

programme.title: The Bob's Burgers Movie
programme.desc: Bob Belcher and wife Linda run a hamburger restaurant in a close-knit seaside community. Stress piles on the couple's shoulders when a water main ruptures and creates a huge sinkhole in front of their business. Meanwhile, Belcher children Tina, Gene and Louise solve a murderous mystery. Animated comedy, with the voices of H John Benjamin, John Roberts, Kristen Schaal and Dan Mintz.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A downtrodden handyman is forced to look after his niece and nephew. He soon wins them over with his knack for telling exciting stories, but to their surprise the tall tales start coming true - and as the children make their own suggestions, the results become even more incredible. Fantasy comedy, starring Adam Sandler, Keri Russell, Guy Pearce and Russell Brand.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: The adventures of the boy who never grows old, as he whisks Wendy Darling and her brothers away to the magical world of Neverland - where they come face to face with fearsome Captain Hook. Adaptation of JM Barrie's fantasy novel, starring Jeremy Sumpter, Rachel Hurd-Wood, Jason Isaacs and Lynn Redgrave.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Father of the Bride
programme.desc: A doting dad is taken aback when his daughter announces she is getting married, and is thrown into a whirlwind of increasingly complicated wedding plans, a struggle to live up to the expectations of his wealthy future in-laws and the sad realisation that his little girl has grown up. Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A fairy falls in love with an ambitious human nobleman, who betrays her in pursuit of claiming the throne. She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

programme.title: Prometheus
programme.desc: A spacecraft is sent to another world, following clues left in ancient artefacts, in search of aliens that may have created the human race. However, the explorers on board discover the extraterrestrials may not be the benevolent creatures they imagined, while the company funding the expedition has its own agenda. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller and Alien prequel, starring Noomi Rapace, Michael Fassbender, Charlize Theron and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen arrives in an isolated community of youngsters, with no memory of who he is or the outside world. When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E3Adolf Hitler's father was a violent, abusive man. His mother doted on her young son. This episode delves deep into the psychology of Hitler as the narcissistic child who grew into a malignant psychopath full of rage and deep hatred.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E4Four women who had the misfortune to be pursued by Hitler saw only one way out of the relationship. His beloved niece took her own life and a German film star he was seeing fell from a balcony to her death.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E1Adolf Hitler had a depraved sex life that he tried to keep hidden from the German public. He was said to be a chronic masturbator, a voyeur and that he engaged in sado-masochistic sex with women.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E2Hitler wanted the world to believe he possessed super-human qualities but in private he was a wreck. This episode reveals the archives that confirm Hitler’s genital deformity, the alarming truth about his heavy drug addiction and the Parkinson’s.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4Two of the most produced combat machines in World War II managed to stay relevant until the end of the war through constant modernization and new variants.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E7Historian Neil Faulkner tells the story of Lawrence of Arabia and his pioneering guerilla warfare against the railways of the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E8This episode features tales of the heroism of the railway staff during the Blitz, and how a small siding in a Hampshire railway station played its part in the preparations for D-Day.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E3In 2008, nearly 850 people are killed in the Russo-Georgian War. How did it erupt and what is the current relationship between the two nations?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E4Soviet troops withdraw from Afghanistan in 1989 after fighting a force funded by the US. Should the US be blamed for the rise of Islamic terrorism.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E5Stunning, newly colorised combat and newsreel footage plus personal memoirs take us to the heart of a battle that would be a catastrophic blow to both sides and leave a muddy graveyard across East Belgium.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E6Rare newsreel and amateur footage, newly colorised, take us inside Hitler's crumbling empire and onto the front lines of the firefight for the streets of Berlin, a battle that will determine the fate of World War II.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: E4July 1943. For six months, the German advance has stalled, but Hitler is convinced that his new generation of Nazi tanks will help put the Reich back on the path to European domination. His target: the Soviet town of Kursk.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5The Soviet Union produced a large variety of tanks and airplanes during World War II. What made the T34 and the Chaika stand out and become icons?

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E10Experts look at three types of weapon employed to attack civilian populations, from the medieval trebuchet to modern bio-weapons and nuclear bombs.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: Combat Machines

programme.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: A bachelor vows to give up violence for love until a gangster targets her kin.

programme.title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
programme.desc: An Indian man working as a taxi driver in America plans to marry into money, but a penniless friend is in love with him.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Some of the best soundtracks of Bollywood uncut

programme.title: The Bhootnii
programme.desc: After a heartbreak, Shantanu unknowingly summons a spirit named Mohabbat, whose obsessive presence soon unsettles him and throws the entire college campus into chaos

programme.title: Naseeb Apna Apna
programme.desc: Chanda is shocked to learn that her husband has married another woman in the city. Now Chanda must either accept it as her destiny, or fight back.

programme.title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
programme.desc: Sattu is a good hearted but good for nothing LLB fail guy who dreams of marrying the IT girl of Ahmedabad Katha, a girl way out of his league. Comedy, starring Kartik Aaryan

programme.title: Doodh Ka Karz
programme.desc: A snake charmer's son grows up and seeks revenge for his father's death. In this battle, Suraj gets help from his father's loyal snake.

programme.title: Chitchor
programme.desc: Gauri finds herself torn between two charming suitors who arrive in her village, each vying for her affection. Will she follow her heart or choose practicality?

programme.title: Tezaab
programme.desc: In his college days, Mahesh squabbles with Mohini, but realizes he's in love with her. Will they have a fairytale ending?

programme.title: Phool Aur Kaante
programme.desc: Ajay, son of crime boss Nageshwar, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his son-forcing him into the underworld to save his child and confront his dark legacy.

programme.title: Iqbal
programme.desc: Drama about a young deaf and dumb Muslim man who pursues his dream of becoming a professional cricket player. Shreyas Talpade stars

programme.title: Raazi
programme.desc: Thriller telling the true story of an Indian female spy who risked everything to go undercover in the lead-up to 1971's Indo-Pakistani war. Starring Alia Bhatt

programme.title: Mili
programme.desc: Mili, a nursing graduate, wishes to relocate to Canada. However, unfathomable circumstances come to the fore as she inadvertently gets trapped in a freezer

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: A woman's relentless pursuit of wealth threatens her relationship with her husband.

programme.title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
programme.desc: When Suraj secretly marries a village woman, his domineering mother schemes to drive his bride out.

programme.title: Sholay
programme.desc: Two convicts are recruited to capture a fearsome bandit. Indian musical adventure, with Dharmendra and Amitabh Bachchan

programme.title: Jodi No. 1
programme.desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

programme.title: Odela 2
programme.desc: Tirupathi mysteriously returns from the dead, unleashing terror in the village. Amidst a failed investigation, hope emerges in Shiva Shakti, a fierce Naaga Sadhu and Shiva devotee

programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: Film traces the journey of a spirited young couple, being hunted by a ruthless mercenary. Will the star-crossed lovers find their fairy-tale ending?

programme.title: Dabangg
programme.desc: A corrupt police officer must decide where his loyalties lie when his enemies use his half-brother against him. Musical crime drama, with Salman Khan and Sonakshi Sinha

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Nandini and Mr Sanjay Verma are lovers who conspire to take over the estate of Mr Saxena by conspiring a plot to kill his widowed daughter Arti

programme.title: Film - Golak Bugni Te Batua
programme.desc: A young couple escapes their feuding families and elopes, only to face new troubles when they check into a hotel during demonetization, leading to chaos, confusion, and unexpected challenges.

programme.title: Dheeyan Meriyan
programme.desc: Vimla confronts Harjinder and announces Harman and Roop's divorce. Harman reveals that Sargun helped him bail Vimla out and angers Harjinder. Later, Yuvraj makes a promise to Roop.

programme.title: Chhoti Jathani
programme.desc: Yashpal joins the Bajwas for lunch and threatens to expose Savreen before her family. Navdeep sets up a police kiosk outside Ajooni's school to keep a tab on her. Later, Zorawar suspects Yashpal.

programme.title: Geet Dholi
